mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalActivity, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS successActivity, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS failedActivity, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS ongoingActivity FROM `activity` WHERE create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} AND status <> 4

SELECT COUNT(*) AS refundTotal, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS refundAmount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN o.order_no IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN r.amount <> o.pay_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS mismatchCount FROM `refund` r LEFT JOIN `order_info` o ON o.order_no = r.order_no
SELECT r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.amount AS amount, r.status AS status, r.refund_time AS refundTime FROM `refund` r ORDER BY r.refund_time DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT l.id AS leaderId, u.real_name AS leaderName, l.community AS community, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS SIGNED) AS activityCount, CAST(COUNT(o.id) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS gmv, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN a.id END) AS SIGNED) AS successActivity, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status <> 4 THEN a.id END) AS SIGNED) AS validActivity FROM `leader` l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN `activity` a ON a.leader_id = l.id LEFT JOIN `order_info` o ON o.activity_id = a.id AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY l.id, u.real_name, l.community ORDER BY gmv DESC, orderCount DESC, l.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id AS id, a.id AS activityId, a.title AS title, u.real_name AS leaderName, l.community AS community, p.name AS pointName, a.target_num AS targetNum, a.current_num AS currentNum, g.group_price AS groupPrice, a.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endTime FROM `activity` a LEFT JOIN `leader` l ON l.id = a.leader_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN `pickup_point` p ON p.id = a.point_id
LEFT JOIN `goods` g ON g.id = (SELECT MIN(g2.id) FROM `goods` g2 WHERE g2.activity_id = a.id) WHERE a.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_no AS orderNo, u.real_name AS userName, a.title AS activityTitle, g.name AS goodsName, o.num AS num, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS payTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM `order_info` o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN `activity` a ON a.id = o.activity_id LEFT JOIN `goods` g ON g.id = o.goods_id WHERE o.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS id, r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.pay_no AS payNo, r.amount AS amount, r.reason AS reason, r.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(r.refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM `refund` r WHERE r.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
